edits.new:
The baseline declares no new table, no new column and no migration, and it enumerates no business value: every list, code and threshold is referenced with its identifier and its version. **No personal data** appears in any element, fake or example; the fixture identifiers are synthetic.

Screen states of the two asset reads that answer SCR-21 and SCR-22: empty, when the read returns no asset; loading, while the read is pending; error, one of the declared error codes (400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 503); no access, the 403 answer of the declared rights.

Reference data: the reads take every list by its identifier and version from the reference-data contract (DP-06, DP-07), namely LOV-LISTING, LOV-HOLDING, LOV-ASSET-TYPE, LOV-TRANSFER-IN and LOV-SALE-CHANNEL; the ten working days are read as a parameter from the parameter contract (DP-06, DP-07), and its parameter key is not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S5-E4029-CON-20).
